Coach Defensive-System Ranking

Head coaches ranked by their isolated effect on their team's defensive SYSTEM over the last ~10 years. Built from the xG-based team fixed effect (the chance quality a team concedes net of its players — goalie-independent), with a two-way (coach + team + season) fixed-effects model so the rating is separated from roster quality and era. Coaches who switch teams carry the identification. Positive = stronger defensive system.

def_eff = primary xG-system effect (goalie-independent). ΔVeff and HLDeff are secondary cross-checks (ΔV-against; high-danger goals-against). GAeff = raw goals-against, which is goalie-driven. "goalie-aided" = ranks much better on raw goals than on the chance-quality system (rode the goalie); "strong system" = the system suppresses chances better than the raw results (unlucky goaltending).

Defensive Talent

Isolated and on-ice defensive profiles (current season, 5v5). The D-zone chart is the teammate- and opponent-isolated Set Def / Rush Def RAPMs; the others are on-ice descriptive rates. Higher Set/Rush Def = better; in the pace/chaos and tidbit charts a lower "against" axis is better. Filter by position and team; type to highlight a player.

Isolated D-zone defense — set-play vs rush (higher = better)

Pace vs Chaos — on-ice events for vs against /60

Goalie SV% — on-ice vs off-ice (above the line = better with you on)
